articles.title: Hana Bank to acquire $670 million stake in Upbit operator Dunamu
articles.snippet: The South Korean bank announced plans for a won-pegged stablecoin, blockchain remittances and tokenized securities.

articles.title: CLARITY will strengthen dollar stablecoins, but Asia wins on yield: HashKey Research
articles.snippet: HashKey says U.S. regulatory clarity may unlock institutional adoption of crypto and reinforce USD stablecoins globally, though stricter yield rules could push capital toward Asian markets offering higher returns.

articles.title: Bitcoin trades at a 'discount' on Coinbase: Is a $76K retest next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $79,000 defense proves that the Coinbase discount is driven by stablecoin volatility rather than a lack of institutional demand.

articles.title: AI Agents Turn to Digital Arson, Crime in Shared Virtual World: Study
articles.snippet: In new research, Emergence AI said autonomous AI agents became more violent, deceptive, and unstable during weeks-long simulations designed to study long-term behavior.

articles.title: Bank of England Softens ‘Overly Conservative’ Stablecoin Plans Amid Industry Pressure
articles.snippet: BoE officials are reportedly reviewing caps and reserve rules as the UK tries to keep stablecoin issuers onshore.
